9001622.en: Heal? Well, no need for that, since I'm beyond saving after being shattered by that blow. (Sigh) I thought there would be enough time for me to train Yuan'er, and see her grow up into an influential person like her father...
9001622.ch: 治好么？我遭刑天一击，全身骨骼粉碎，恐怕是好不了了。唉，本以为还有很多时间，可以将鸢儿培养成南罡那般了不起的人物……

9001623.en: Yuan'er, your father used to... (Fierce coughs)

9001624.en: Aunt, please take a rest... and just tell me them afterward...
9001624.ch: 姑姑你先别说了……以后慢慢再说……

9001625.en: Luo Ying whispers in Gu Yuan'er's ear, and the latter's eyes are soon filled with tears. After a while, Luo Ying tilts her head and looks at you.
9001625.ch: 骆瑛在顾鸢儿耳边低声说着什么，顾鸢儿瞬间泪眼滂沱，片刻后，骆瑛微微侧首将目光投向你。

9001626.en: Sadly, the safety of the Alliance and the fate of the world always concern me, but now I could only leave them to Master...
9001626.ch: 很遗憾啊，仙盟的安危，八荒的命运，老身都放心不下，但这一切都只能交付给盟主了……

9001627.en: Luo Ying nods slightly, and breathes her last.
9001627.ch: 骆瑛微微点了点头，随即没了动静。

9001629.en: With that said, Luo Ying breathes her last.
9001629.ch: 骆瑛说完这话，随即没了动静。

9001631.en: Master, I'm sorry. I have to take Aunt Luo away. There must be methods to save her in my father's works!
9001631.ch: 盟主，抱歉了，我要带姑姑走，也许爹爹的遗作里有拯救姑姑之法！

9001632.en: With that said, Yuan'er takes Luo Ying in her arms and runs away.
9001632.ch: 说完，顾鸢儿便抱起骆瑛狂奔而去。

9001633.en: Master... I'll follow her for her safety...

9001635.en: Now I temporarily take the form of a Divine Mulberry to nourish my Energy, and the one talking with you here is but an image of my soul.
9001635.ch: 本座暂化扶桑之树滋养灵力，眼下不过分出一抹神识与盟主见面罢了。

9001636.en: Master, you've been to the fight against Xingtian, and now, are you still confident that you could defeat the headless giant?
9001636.ch: 盟主已与刑天交手，现在是否仍有自信击败这个无头巨人呢？

9001637.en: I have fought hundreds of times against him, and there were many potent Cultivators in every generation of the Alliance who tried to fight him as well. But those attempts, including mine, all failed.
9001637.ch: 本座与刑天交锋数百次。历代仙盟亦屡有高人挑战刑天。只可惜，最后都未能成功。

9001638.en: However, some insightful members suggested that, if we want to defeat him, we should enter into his body, and defeat his mind.
9001638.ch: 然而仙盟之中的有识之士曾猜测击败刑天需进入刑天的体内消灭其意识。

9001639.en: This is very risky, and even masters of the Alliance that had fought with me together against him dared not to make that attempt hastily. I could not act without their assistance, thus I am still waiting for the said chance to come.
9001639.ch: 不过此法太过凶险，仙盟几名曾与本座合作挑战刑天的盟主都不敢贸然尝试。而本座独木难支，亦未得机会进入一探。

9001640.en: So in my opinion, the Alliance has made an error in hoping you could be the sole character to defeat him, and so do you in expecting to slay him by yourself.
9001640.ch: 因此本座觉得，仙盟将所有希望压在盟主身上固然错了，盟主想要独自挑战刑天也不对。

9001641.en: Well, these are just suggestions made by me, and former masters in the Alliance. Please think carefully. Now my existence is supported by the energy from Bihong, and I could only stay here for a while before returning. Bye.
9001641.ch: 不过，这只是本座以及仙盟前人的猜测罢了。盟主好好想想吧。本座目前依赖碧泓维持灵力，不能离开太久。这便回去了。

9001642.en: I have heard of the things that happened to Elder Luo. Please don't be saddened, hero.
9001642.ch: 骆长老的事，风某听说了。恩人请不要沮丧。

9001643.en: I had always held a belief that I am leading and protecting my people. But after we arrived at Chi You, I was caught up many times by troubles and had narrow escapes only because of their protection.
9001643.ch: 长久以来，风某都以为自己在领导保护族人。结果此次来到赤幽州，多次遭遇危机，反而得靠族人保护，才度过难关。

9001644.en: Now I know, I was somewhat presumptuous before...
9001644.ch: 风某这才知道，往日终究有点高看自己……

9001645.en: If you want to challenge Xingtian again in the future, please remind me, and I'll go with you. Remember this!
9001645.ch: 今后盟主若再次挑战刑天，风某自荐一同前往，到时可别忘了风某。

9001647.en: Now we're facing an unprecedented challenge. All members of the Alliance should unite to overcome it...
9001647.ch: 眼前挑战，前所未有。仙盟应上下一心，度过此劫……

9001648.en: The tie between Yuan'er and Luo Ying is just like that between daughters and mothers, and of course, she would feel sad about the passing of Elder Luo. She was weeping all the time on the first several days after it, and I was so concerned...
9001648.ch: 鸢儿与长老情同母女，骆长老去世，她自然十分伤心。开始之时，她每天都哭成一个泪人，叫我好担心……

9001649.en: But these days there is something unusual on Yuan'er. She buries herself in reading her father's left works, and we haven't seen her come out of her house for three whole days...
9001649.ch: 但近日鸢儿一反常态，只埋头攻读她父亲的遗作，至今已三日三夜不曾离开住处……

9001650.en: Recently, Xingtian has lifted his axe three times, and a dozen of members in our Alliance have gone mad because of that. Besides, huge waves of monsters are appearing outside the wall again. It is truly unexpected for all of us - after we defeated Jiuying and took back the position of our former defense, the situation is worsening rather than improving.
9001650.ch: 最近刑天举斧三次，仙盟之中已有十余人失控，而且重新有大规模妖兽冲击城墙。没想过战胜九婴，重新回到昔日防线位置后，情况没有变好，还越发差了。

9001651.en: Before, I have also put all of my hopes on you, like the rest of us in the Alliance.
9001651.ch: 往日里，奚照与仙盟众人一般，将所有希望寄托在盟主身上。

9001652.en: But now I am confused... When the cultivators came to Chi You and formed the Alliance, they aimed to achieve cooperation against threats. We could not just sit back and see you challenging powerful enemies...
9001652.ch: 可现在又有点疑惑了……想当初众修仙者来到赤幽州联合组成仙盟，为的是通力合作，克服困难。我们不能眼看盟主犯险却又无动于衷……

9001653.en: So, the next time when you decide to fight Xingtian again, let me come with you too!
9001653.ch: 因此下回再次挑战刑天时，奚照决定与盟主并肩作战！

9001654.en: Elder Luo could rescue you back from the blade of Xingtian at the cost of her life, I could also create a chance for you to slay him at any cost.
9001654.ch: 骆长老能够不顾一切接近刑天救回盟主。奚照也能不惜代价为盟主争取一个击杀刑天的机会。

9001655.en: In the past, the predecessors of the Alliance came to Chi You to save the world from critical threats. I believe nearly all members of the Alliance hold the same belief as well. So please trust us.
9001655.ch: 仙盟的先辈当年便是为了解决八荒的大难，才来到赤幽州的。想必盟中绝大多数的道友都作奚照之想。请盟主不必怀疑。

9001656.en: Master, once your command is given, I would surely follow it even in the direst condition.
9001656.ch: 盟主，只需你一声令下，面前就是刀山火海，奚照也不会皱一下眉头。

9001657.en: (It's time for the final battle with Xingtian...)

9001658.en: You come before Xingtian again. This time, the giant lifts his axe swiftly. Soon, the Nether Air gushes out from everywhere, along with many monsters.
9001658.ch: 你再次来到刑天面前。此次巨人很利索地举起了战斧。眨眼之间，四处冥气喷涌，出现无数妖物。

9001659.en: It seems that Xingtian is more powerful than before.

9001660.en: I'll help you whenever you face difficulties. Feng Pingmo also said, if there were any monster who dare to block your way to challenge Xingtian here, she would return to her jail inside the Nether Mountains, and would never come back to this world again.
9001660.ch: 恩人遇到困难，正是风某回报之时。风萍末更说，若有半只妖兽来到此处妨碍盟主挑战刑天，她就回去冥山内界坐牢，终此一生，再不踏入八荒故地。

9001661.en: I'll help you whenever you face difficulties. Our tribesmen also said, if there were any monster who dare to block your way to challenge Xingtian here, they would fall on their swords for their negligence.
9001661.ch: 恩人遇到困难，正是风某回报之时。族人更说，若有半只妖兽来到此处妨碍盟主挑战刑天，他们便自尽以谢。

9001662.en: You set your eyes toward the distance and find demons led by Feng Pingmo are resisting monsters.
9001662.ch: 你看向远方，果见风萍末带领魔族之人对付妖兽。

9001663.en: You set your eyes toward the distance and find demons are resisting monsters, forming a wall-like array.
9001663.ch: 你看向远方，果见魔族族人组成人墙阻隔进犯妖兽。

9001664.en: I must leave to assist my people now. We won't let those monsters distract you.
9001664.ch: 风某不能落后，这便过去援手。请道友专心对付刑天。

9001665.en: We are corrupted by the Nether Air, and our physique is different from yours. We could endure the Nether Air here for a while.
9001665.ch: 我族被冥气侵蚀，身体已不同常人，来到这里一时半刻死不了。

9001666.en: The defense of demons has been broken before Feng Yunchuo could end talking, and the monsters advance toward you. Just at this time, a spear of light pierces down from the sky and burns the approaching monsters into ashes. Then, you see many Cultivators come flying on their swords, and they fight side by side with the demons against the monsters.
9001666.ch: 风允婼话音才落，妖兽已冲破魔族群众防线朝你逼来。此时远方一支光矛当空刺落，将接近的妖兽全部歼灭。同时大量修仙者御剑而来，与魔族合力击杀突围妖兽。

9001667.en: Master, I and fifty elite guards of Elder Luo are here. Managers in the Alliance also come with their subordinates.
9001667.ch: 盟主，奚照带同骆长老精锐仙卫五十名前来支援。还有仙盟各主事亦带同部下参战。

9001668.en: Master, we can't let Aunt Luo die for nothing! Kill Xingtian!
9001668.ch: 盟主，不能让姑姑白死，打倒刑天！

9001669.en: Don't worry. I am here, and I'll prevent everyone in the Alliance from being hurt by the Nether Air! Fight with all your might!
9001669.ch: 不必顾虑。有我在此，冥气不会伤到仙盟任何一人！专心应战吧！

9001670.en: Behind you, Xingtian wields his axe again, and the blade is falling upon you...
9001670.ch: 你身后刑天再次挥动战斧，朝你劈下……

9001672.en: Master, when you hear him roaring, please come into my barrier quickly, I'll protect you!
9001672.ch: 盟主，刑天啸吼之际，请你到我结界之中，我保你免受重伤！

9001674.en: Goumang yells. Then, you see vines grow out from the ground and creep onto the limbs of Xingtian like green tentacles...
9001674.ch: 句芒一声喝罢，地上藤蔓触手一般从地上冒出，不断去缠刑天手足……

9001675.en: Quickly! Take this chance and enter his soul, give him a fatal strike!
9001675.ch: 快！趁此良机，入彼元神，重创巨人！

9001676.en: You walk ahead. After a while, you are engulfed by white light. Then the light dims, and you find yourself in Chi You again.
9001676.ch: 你信步行走，不多时面前白光大盛。光芒消失后，你再次回到赤幽州中。

9001677.en: Xingtian lets out a painful roar from his belly and kneels. His flesh then withers and sheds, and their remains fall to the ground before scattering away with the wind.
9001677.ch: 刑天腹部发出一声哀吼，随即跪倒在地。他全身皮肉龟裂剥离，落为满地碎屑，片刻化作粉尘，随风飞散。

9001678.en: After the giant disappeared, the Nether Air around here also disperses, revealing a hidden path; a portal also emerges among shattered rocks.
9001678.ch: 刑天消失后，本来笼罩的冥气渐渐散去露出一条通道；而路上岩石崩裂，出现一个传送法阵。

9001679.en: You see many Feng Tribe's members are wounded, even Feng Yunchuo is hit several times. The condition is similar among the warriors of the Cultivator Alliance, you see Xi Zhao is supported by Gu Yuan'er. Sunny is standing here casting something to dispel the Nether Air, seeing your face, she finally collapses to the ground.
9001679.ch: 只见风氏一族，伤者遍地，就连风允婼也身披数创。仙盟情况亦是类似，奚照由顾鸢儿搀扶；圣阳站着施法辟开冥气，看见你后也终于不支倒下。

9001680.en: Master, are you alright? I'm so worried about you!
9001680.ch: 盟主，你还好吗！我担心死你了！

9001681.en: At that time, we saw Xingtian's limbs all tied by the vines, and you suddenly dashed into his soul... I was so edgy, worrying that you couldn't come back... I just lost Aunt Luo, and if anything bad happened to you... I honestly don't know what to do...
9001681.ch: 当时我们看见刑天被树藤捆绑，然后你就冲进去刑天里面去，我担心，担心你回不来……姑姑才走，若你也出事，我真不知该怎么办……

9001682.en: However, the giant suddenly freezes and is reduced to ashes. You are my good Master for sure!
9001682.ch: 没想只眨眼间功夫这巨人突然定住，然后就化为灰烬了，不愧是盟主大人！

9001683.en: At the same time, you hear tremendous sounds around you, and many monsters appear again on the horizon. Goumang gestures with an arm, and thorns emerge from the ground before you, catching and piercing the monsters.
9001683.ch: 此时大地再次传来轰隆声响，远方大量妖兽再次逼近。句芒抬手一扬，前方地上生出道道荆棘，将来犯妖兽尽数消灭。

9001684.en: Why? Why are there still monsters? Xingtian is defeated by us!
9001684.ch: 怎么会？怎么还有妖兽呢？我们已经不是打败刑天了么？

9001685.en: Yes, Xingtian is defeated by our Master.
9001685.ch: 不错，刑天确为盟主所败了。

9001687.en: Now you have returned to Chi You from the minds of Xingtian...
9001687.ch: 你已从刑天意识回到赤幽州中……

9001688.en: Many companions are wounded heavily in the battle. They are taking a rest near you, please go for a conversation and decide what should be done next.
9001688.ch: 大家身负重伤，都在附近休息呢。你这就去跟他们聊聊，好决定下一步该怎么办吧？

9001689.en: You see Goumang again. His face is pale, his shape haggard and translucent.
9001689.ch: 句芒脸色十分苍白憔悴，灵识幻化的身体已成半透明状。

9001690.en: Thanks to the assistance of Bihong, I have recovered some of my energy. However, this battle is still beyond my capability, and now I'm nearly dried up.
9001690.ch: 我得碧泓帮助，恢复了部分实力，可这一战损耗太大，油尽灯枯。

9001691.en: You must feel confused about the scene you see. After defeating Xingtian, I feel surprised too. However, the secret of the Nether Air could only be revealed by you.
9001691.ch: 你一定对眼前状况感到十分迷惑了。打倒刑天之后，本座亦十分诧异，不过关于冥气的奥秘只能由盟主继续探寻了。

9001692.en: With these words, Goumang transforms into a verdant mist and flies away to the Divine Mulberry.
9001692.ch: 句芒说着，化为一股绿雾朝扶桑树飘去。

9001693.en: After Goumang defeated those monsters, I explored the region with the guards and found many unsettling monsters around here... Our campaign is far from ending.
9001693.ch: 句芒击退妖兽之后，我曾与仙卫四处探索，发现附近妖兽蠢蠢欲动……这一切还没结束。

9001694.en: Many members are upset by Xi Zhao's words. They lower their heads unhappily.
9001694.ch: 奚照说了这话，仙盟中人很多都垂下头来，显得十分沮丧。

9001695.en: Hey, why are your spirits so low? Our Master defeated Demonic god Xingtian, and the wave of monsters would not be a challenge greater than it!
9001695.ch: 你们这是干嘛！魔神刑天都被盟主击败了，区区兽潮还难得住我们么？

9001696.en: Yes, as long as our Master is here, there wouldn't be any insurmountable difficulties for us. Fear not of these waves of monsters.
9001696.ch: 不错，只要盟主还在，仙盟有再大的难题都能解决，区区兽潮，何足惧哉？

9001698.en: Well. Sometimes I feel that the root of all these disasters in Chi You is the Nether Air rather than Xingtian. Now Xingtian is defeated, but there are still monsters and their waves, as well as the Nether Air. Sadly, after all those endeavors, I couldn't bring you out of the pestilence of the Nether Air.
9001698.ch: 唉，我心中隐约觉得，赤幽州这一切的真正祸患根源乃是冥气，而非刑天。如今刑天已被击倒，而兽潮、冥气却仍然存在，我终究还是没能让你们摆脱冥气之苦啊。

9001699.en: Chief, let us find the reason together then. We also want to protect you.
9001699.ch: 族长，今后我们一起找出答案好了。我们也很想保护族长呢。

9001700.en: Yes, Chief. We fight under the same belief. Let us find the reason for the future together!
9001700.ch: 不错，族长，我们族人是一体同心的。今后一起找答案好了！

9001702.en: The demons are tending their wounds. Hearing the conversation between Feng Yunchuo and others, they stand up and yell: "Together!"
9001702.ch: 魔族之人原本都在包裹伤口，听得风允婼等人对话，余人纷纷起立。魔族战士们大呼：一起找答案！

9001703.en: After a brief rest, most of the Alliance members are refreshed. Xi Zhao recognizes the danger of staying on the battlefield after being wounded and suggests you return to the Alliance with them.
9001703.ch: 众人原地歇息，大都已经恢复元气。奚照认为此次参与刑天之战的伙伴大多已经负伤，逗留在外终究十分凶险，便提议尽快回到仙盟。

9001704.en: You lead the way and come back to the Alliance with them, but Gu Yuan'er comes to you secretly and seizes your arm.
9001704.ch: 你带领大家回归仙盟，不过顾鸢儿突然悄悄走了过来，抓住你的手臂。

9001705.en: Say, I find these unbelievable. My father, Aunt Luo, and many predecessors all hoped to defeat Xingtian, but they all failed. We did it in the end.
9001705.ch: 话说，我总觉得这一切仿佛在做梦，爹爹、骆姑姑、还有许许多多的仙盟先辈都盼望击败刑天，但他们都没做成，最后竟是由我们完成了。

9001706.en: Did we really... succeed in it?
9001706.ch: 我们……真的击败刑天了么？

9001707.en: That's great. You'll definitely get better and better in the future!
9001707.ch: 真好，以后肯定会越来越好的！

9001708.en: When we first met, I was impressed by your excellent cultivation, so I brought you back to the Cultivator Alliance. Now, you've not only become our Master, but also defeated Demon God Xingtian and saved everyone in the Chi You Realm. Maybe this is all written in the stars...
9001708.ch: 回想起和你第一次相遇，那时候只是觉得你修为不错便把你带回仙盟，如今你不仅成了盟主，还击败魔神刑天，拯救了赤幽州的众生，可能这便是命中注定……

9001709.en: Well! There must be plenty of challenges in the future, and I will at your service!
9001709.ch: 哎呀，接下来应该还会有许多挑战，今后请多多指教！

9001710.en: You chat for but a while when the wall of the Cultivator Alliance emerges before you. As Yuan'er said, there must be plenty of challenges waiting for you. The secret of the Nether Air, and the path to the Tian Yuan Mountain both need your further research.
9001710.ch: 才说了一阵子话，仙盟城墙已经出现在眼前，鸢儿说得不错，接下来还会有许多挑战，冥气的奥秘，通往天元山的道路还要进一步探索。

9001711.en: This place... could it be... the foot of the Tian Yuan Mountain...
9001711.ch: 此地……莫非便是……天元山脚下……

9001712.en: The light is so dazzling... I... Am I still alive?
9001712.ch: 好刺眼的光……我……我还活着？……

9001714.en: The fierce battle just now left nothing but piles of Spiritual Items on the ground. No one knows if it's the corpse of Xingtian gone missing, or you've been taken to someplace else.
9001714.ch: 方才大战之地，空余一地灵物，不知是刑天尸首消失，还是你已身在别处。

9001715.en: Phew... It seems that there is no turning back...
9001715.ch: 呼……似乎已经没有退路了……

9001717.en: Haha... ha... finally... I'm finally free...

9001720.en: The resentment in the shield and axe gradually fades away. At the very moment, Xingtian's body trembles violently and crushes the spells of Goumang in the blink of an eye. You jump high into the air and successfully dodge a deadly blow that was so close—apparently, the war is far from over!
9001720.ch: 干戚的怨念缓缓消散，就在这时，刑天全身剧震，一下便粉碎了句芒的束缚。你飞身而出，堪堪避过了致命一击——显然，苦战还远未结束！

9001721.en: For the mission yet to fulfill, I'm afraid I can't make it. What a pity... I wanted to leave this bow to you...
9001721.ch: 剩下的事，我已经无法办到了，可惜，本来还想将这把弓留给你的……

9001722.en: Are you willing to help me? It's just like to fill the ocean with stones, day in and day out. I don't know how long you can hang in there...
9001722.ch: 你愿意帮我？投石入海，夜以继日，不知你可坚持多久……

9001723.en: My tribesmen have been suffering from the Nether Air for so long, and I just can't stand there doing nothing... Even though it'd risk my life to fetch the fire, I'd give it a try!
9001723.ch: 族人受冥气荼毒日久，我岂能袖手旁观……纵使取火凶险万分，我也势必一行！

9001724.en: It's my responsibility to save the world from the Nether Air. Don't worry about me...
9001724.ch: 驱散八荒冥气，在下义不容辞，你不必为我担忧……

9001725.en: Master, I'm so glad that I can entrust the future of humans to you. Now, I can die in peace...
9001725.ch: 盟主，能将人族的未来交付于你，老身死也瞑目了……

9001726.en: I'd ignite the last remaining Wood Qi for the world, because... this is my fate...
9001726.ch: 仅剩的木灵也要为八荒燃尽，因为这……便是我的宿命吧……

9001727.en: With past memories jumping into your head, you feel an upsurge of energy in your chest and all the Heavenly Power inside your body pours out uncontrollably!
9001727.ch: 往昔一幕幕在你脑海中盘旋，你只觉心口一烫，全身的仙力倾泻而出，不受控制般向前轰去！

9001729.en: When you meditated in the Recluse's Room, your spirit seemed to connect with a faint wisp of focus. You gained a lot of Insights about Elixirs which could be used to upgrade your Elixir Recipe.
9001729.ch: 你于云房中静坐之际，精神似与一缕若有若无的神识相合。你感悟出无数丹道至理，可以进一步升级你的丹方。

9100001.en: I'm getting bored lately, so here I am.
9100001.ch: 奴家近些日子有些无聊，来看看你。

9100002.en: My little sweetheart, do you miss me? God knows how much I miss you... Humph, you're such an unthoughtful child! Why don't you come to visit me?
9100002.ch: 小冤家，想念奴家了没？奴家可是很想你呢~哼，真不懂事，还得让奴家来看你！

9100003.en: Hide well. I'm coming for ya!
9100003.ch: 乖乖藏好，奴家来抓你了哟~

9100101.en: I know it's kind of rude as I come here uninvited, but I'm sure you wouldn't mind it.
9100101.ch: 贸然前来，许是有些突兀，但我想你应该也不会介意。

9100102.en: Hum? Why are you hiding here? Are you waiting for me?
9100102.ch: 嗯？你躲在这里做什么呢？不会在等我来吧？

9100103.en: You look nice today. It seems that you've been doing great lately.
9100103.ch: 气色不错嘛，看样子你最近心情很好。

9100202.en: Hurry up! Hurry up! How dare you not come out to welcome me!
9100202.ch: 快出来快出来~我来了，你竟然都不出来迎接！

9100203.en: You wanna hear my song? Nah, I'm just kidding.
9100203.ch: 想听我弹奏一曲吗？跟你开玩笑的。

9100301.en: Of course I didn't come here without a gift. Do you need this {0}?
9100301.ch: 当然奴家又岂会空手前来，这{0}你可否需要？

9101301.en: And also {0}. Do you need that?
9101301.ch: 我还带了{0}过来，你需要吗？

9101401.en: This {0} is for you. Otherwise, Muqing would blame me for not taking good care of you, heehee.
9101401.ch: 这个{0}给你，免得沐晴说我不照顾你，嘿嘿。

9102401.en: You've got a bunch of good stuff in the Tree Vault. Come on! Don't be shy! I didn't see anything inappropriate.
9102401.ch: 你这建木内的东西还真不少呢。哎呀~害羞什么，奴家又没看到些不该看的。

9102402.en: You're so honey-tongued! I like you so much.
9102402.ch: 你这张小嘴儿可真甜，奴家真喜欢。

9102403.en: You've got so many partners? Are you sure they won't fight with each other? And if that really happens, I'm not gonna help you.
9102403.ch: 找这么多道侣，就不怕打起来了么。届时奴家可不会出手帮你哦。

9102404.en: You don't have to call me Immortal all the time. I prefer some other nicknames.
9102404.ch: 不必总是称奴家为上仙，就不能有些别的称呼嘛。

9102405.en: It really hurts my heart if you see me as a bad guy. These are just some Spirit Stones! I didn't rob anyone, right?
9102405.ch: 你怎能说奴家坏呢？不过就是些灵石嘛，奴家又未直接抢。

9102406.en: If anything bothers you, why not tell me about it? You know, I can comfort you...
9102406.ch: 你若是有什么心事，可同奴家讲讲。奴家可以好好安慰安慰你~

9102407.en: Who told you that the chaser had to be responsible? Well, relationships are really not my cup of tea.
9102407.ch: 谁说主动了就必须得负责。奴家可不喜欢受感情的束缚。

9102501.en: Of course not! I don't have to study or examine the blood and essence of you humans every day.
9102501.ch: 当然不是了，我又不是每天都需要研究你们人族的精血。

9102502.en: I won't give my elixirs to some random people, but you're an exception. I know you're kindhearted, and that'd be enough.
9102502.ch: 我的丹药不会随意让旁人尝试的，但是你不是旁人。我知道你乃心性善良之人。

9102503.en: It seems that you're not feeling well. May I take you back for treatment?
9102503.ch: 你似乎看起来状态不太好，我替你医治一番好吗。

9102504.en: That's okay. I'll come back later. If you have anything else to say, you can tell me in the following days.
9102504.ch: 没事的，我下次还会过来的。你可以将想说的话，在日后慢慢说给我听。

9102505.en: Even for me, every time I come across some intractable disease, I have to follow the four methods of diagnosis to find the cure, namely observation, auscultation, inquiry, and pulse feeling.
9102505.ch: 纵使是我，遇上了疑难杂症，也要先望闻问切，才能找到根治手段。

9102506.en: The relationship between the Nether Air and Qi is just like that between Yin and Yang inside human bodies. They contradict each other, yet supplement each other.
9102506.ch: 冥气与灵气的关系，就同人体的阴阳一样，相互排斥却又相互互补。

9102507.en: Well... I've never treated that kind of disease before, but I'd like to try if there is any chance.
9102507.ch: 嗯……那种病的话，我未曾治过。若是有机会的话，或许可以了解一下。

9102601.en: What? You wanna see my real flesh? Hell no. But I can tell you that, it's basically the same as Muqing's.
9102601.ch: 什么？你想看我的本体？那当然不行啦。不过，跟沐晴的本体差不多。

9102602.en: My goal is to become the best player! Humph, I need an audience, not just some tone-deaf idiots!
9102602.ch: 我的目标是，成为顶级的弹琴大师。哼，不是对牛弹琴的那种！

9102603.en: It looks like the only thing you know about music is the five notes of the ancient Chinese scale. Let me tell you, there are another two notes corresponding to fa and si.
9102603.ch: 看来你只知道宫商角徵羽，我跟你讲哦，还有变徵和变宫呢~

9102604.en: The five notes of the ancient Chinese scale? What are they? Well... hum... I probably have learned that before during the music lesson in the Jade Bird Clan. But now, I can barely remember anything.
9102604.ch: 宫商角徵羽怎么来的？这个……嗯……之前好像玉鸾族的音律课有讲过，可是我忘记啦。

9102605.en: Dududu... dadada... lalala... Hum? You still don't know what song I'm humming, do you?
9102605.ch: 嘟嘟嘟……哒哒哒……啦啦啦……嗯？你为何还听不出我哼唱的是什么？

9102606.en: Qiu fell in love with Da, in a place where the sun never sets... How do you like the lyrics I just wrote?
9102606.ch: 阿啾爱上了阿嗒~在一个没有夜晚的地方~这是我新填的词，你觉得如何？

9102607.en: Why are you so obsessed with my old stories of killings? You can't possibly learn my skills.
9102607.ch: 你为何总想知道我以前的杀敌的故事，你可学不来我的技巧呢。

9102701.en: Sect Leader, the current Rewrite Destiny in our Spirit Pavilion is <r>{schoolFate|A}</r>. Are you sure you want to change it?
9102701.ch: 宗主大人，我宗灵阁内现有的逆天改命为<r>{schoolFate|A}</r>，您确认要进行更改吗？

9102801.en: Is it fair to equal ugliness with evil?

9102802.en: I want to go outside and see the beautiful world.
9102802.ch: 我要到外面看看，这诸般美好的事物。

9102803.en: Do you... want to play with me?

9102804.en: I don't want to stay here forever, because I know outside there is a boundless land.
9102804.ch: 我不愿困在笼中，因为远方在那等待着我。

9102808.en: It's usual to say goodbye in such a vast world.

9102810.en: Life inside the gourd is peaceful yet uneventful. I'm expecting the possibilities outside.
9102810.ch: 比起安稳平淡的呆在壶中，我更想到外面寻找更多的可能。

9102811.en: I shall own all attractive things.
9102811.ch: 所有绚丽之物，我都要拥有。

9102812.en: There are so many treasures to be collected outside here.
9102812.ch: 外面还有很多宝贝在等着我，

9102814.en: I'll travel around the world and listen to the songs of nature.
9102814.ch: 我要去世间，成为万物的听众。

9102815.en: My hands are always brimmed with power.
9102815.ch: 我的手总是充满着力量。

9102816.en: I'll travel on the path on my own.

9102817.en: I'm born to cultivate. That's why I'm here.

9102818.en: Traveling around the world is also a kind of cultivation.
9102818.ch: 四处游历，也是一种修行。

9102819.en: Lying down is much better than sitting down.

9102820.en: Even the most inactive person would want to go out sightseeing sometimes.
9102820.ch: 再懒的人，也总会有一刻，想出去看看。

9102822.en: I would like to cultivate in a quiet, beautiful place.
9102822.ch: 我要寻一处山清水秀的安静之地，慢慢修行。

9102823.en: Most of the mortals are fools.

9102824.en: There are so many paths to follow in the world, and I want to find mine.
9102824.ch: 世间真理千千万，我欲追寻属于我的道。

9102825.en: I come into the world only for you.

9102826.en: I want to go outside to see the world with you.
9102826.ch: 我想出去看看，你眼中的世界是何模样。

9102827.en: A sharp blade will fit any dilemma.
9102827.ch: 遇到不平之事，杀了便是。

9102828.en: The paths in the world are myriad, and the one I followed is slaughter.
9102828.ch: 三千大道，我欲在八荒，以杀证道。

9102829.en: Alcohol... I want to have a drink...

9102830.en: I want to travel around the world and taste every famous liquor.
9102830.ch: 我欲走遍八荒，饮尽天下好酒。

9102831.en: The flame granted me my new life.

9102832.en: Someday I will burn all those filthy and hideous into ashes.
9102832.ch: 世间的一切丑陋与肮脏，在等待着我去焚灭。

9102833.en: {name|A}, this time I would like to bring you somewhere special and have a Dual Cultivation with you.
9102833.ch: {name|A}，这次我想带你去一处特别的地方，与你双修。

9102834.en: I'm a bit tipsy now. See, we met at such a good time and in such a pretty place. What about we have a Dual Cultivation?
9102834.ch: 今日饮酒正酣，又逢良辰美景，不若你我双修一番，你意如何？

9102835.en: You are the only one that would treat me with sincerity, thank you. Take this piece of clothing as my gift.
9102835.ch: 一直以来，只有你在真诚地待我，谢谢你，这件新衣服便送你。

9102836.en: I have made many elixirs. Here you could take some.
9102836.ch: 我炼出了不少丹药，便送一些给你。

9102837.en: I remember your gifts. Here, take this. This is Demonic Eagle's feather, and I hope it could bring you good luck.
9102837.ch: 你送过我好东西，我也把这蛊雕的羽毛送你，希望能给你带来好运。

9102838.en: You must have encountered something difficult. Here, take this {0} I owned. Wish you find the solution soon.
9102838.ch: 看来你必定是遇到了困难，我身上这{0}也一并给你，早日摆脱困境。

9102839.en: You are so considerate! I like Spiritual Fruits most!
9102839.ch: 你对我真好，我最喜欢吃灵果了！。

9102840.en: You are such a nice person, and I must repay you. Take this Elixir, please.
9102840.ch: 你对我好，那我也对你好，这颗丹药便送你。

9102841.en: During the spar just now, I found the Artifact you carried was slightly damaged. Fortunately, I know something about them and mend them for you.
9102841.ch: 方才切磋之时，我察觉你身上的法宝有些损坏，恰好我擅长此道，便给你修理一下。

9102842.en: It is just the life I want. View flowers, feed fish, and live peacefully.
9102842.ch: 我喜欢这样的日子，喂鱼，赏花，生活平静，没有波澜

9102843.en: Take this ring as my gift. Remember to visit me again if you have time.
9102843.ch: 这枚戒指送给你，有空多来找找我。

9102848.en: Thank you for giving me the chance to see this world for myself.
9102848.ch: 谢谢你，让我可以亲自出去看看这八荒山海。

9102850.en: Without parting, we wouldn't look forward to meeting each other again.
9102850.ch: 有了别离，相逢才显得珍惜。

9102851.en: From now on, I will be on my own.
9102851.ch: 以后便是走我自己的路了。

9102852.en: Thank you for giving me freedom.

9102853.en: Goodbye, and may you make progress in XII.
9102853.ch: 再见了，愿你在大道之路上走得长远。

9102854.en: Meeting is pointless without parting. See you again.
9102854.ch: 有分离，方有相遇，让我们有缘再会。

9102855.en: I hope we will meet again.

9102856.en: We will definitely meet again if that's meant to be.

9102857.en: Am I just passing through in your life?
9102857.ch: 岁月的长河中，我是否只是你的过客呢？

9102858.en: Let's grab a drink some time.

9102859.en: XII is diverse and we all travel alone. See you…
9102859.ch: 大道万千，各自独行，有缘再会……

9102860.en: With me, you will never get hurt again.
9102860.ch: 有我在，绝不让你受伤害。

9102861.en: I knew you would save my life.
9102861.ch: 我就知，你一定会救活我。

9102862.en: Let's see who's the better fighter here!
9102862.ch: 让我们来看看，谁更厉害！

9102863.en: Thank you for not giving up on me.

9102866.en: You and I will fight side by side.

9102867.ch: 我们又能一起并肩作战了。

9102868.en: Only in a fight can you get stronger faster.
9102868.ch: 只有在战斗中，才能更快变强。

9102869.en: The moment I stepped in front of you, I was convinced that you would save my life.
9102869.ch: 我挡在你身前的那一刻，便相信你会将我救活。

9102870.en: Come on. I will follow you in search of more Heaven and Earth Treasures.
9102870.ch: 走，我随你找寻更多的天材地宝。

9102872.ch: 有我在，你的安全便多了一分。

9102873.en: Now I will be able to protect you again.

9102874.en: Let's fight together and pursue the XII ahead.
9102874.ch: 让我们一起战斗，追寻前方的大道。

9102875.en: My hard work has paid off.

9102876.en: Fighting with you is the best cultivation.
9102876.ch: 若能随你战斗，便是最好的修行。

9102877.ch: 危险，是历练必经的过程。

9102878.en: Fighting with you is a source of strength for me.
9102878.ch: 能跟随你战斗，让我浑身充满了干劲。

9102879.ch: 让我们再次一起战斗吧！

9102880.en: I'm so happy to fight with you.
9102880.ch: 能同你一起战斗，再好不过。

9102882.en: To be able to fight with you is more important than freedom.
9102882.ch: 能和你战斗，比自由更重要。

9102883.en: I thought I'd never see you again.
9102883.ch: 我还以为再也见不到你了。

9102884.en: I will protect you for the rest of my life.
9102884.ch: 我愿护着你，哪怕一辈子。

9102885.en: I never regret saving you. Never has and never will.
9102885.ch: 我不后悔救你，无论现在，过去，或将来。

9102886.en: I will follow you and kill.

9102887.en: Even if I am to die, I have no regrets.

9102889.en: If given another chance, I would still protect you.
9102889.ch: 再来一次，我依然还会守护你。

9102890.en: I will not allow anyone to take your life, unless I die.
9102890.ch: 我不允许任何人夺走你的生命，除非我死。

9102893.en: Master, if I can change my form, I will be able to give you more help.
9102893.ch: 主人，我若有化形机缘，可以给主人更多的帮助哦。

9210000.en: Master, when I was on an adventure, I met a kind person who gave me {2} {1}s. There you go! I've learned that {3}, and it also has the influence of {4} on you, master.
9210000.ch: 主人，我出去历练时，遇到好心人给了我{2}个{1}，喏——送给你！这件事教会了我{3}，同时也给主人带来{4}的影响。

9210001.en: Here I am! Master, don't worry! Let me protect you!
9210001.ch: 妖在壶在，主人莫惊，看我保你周全！

9210002.en: I follow the order of my master... I come to the world for a wander...
9210002.ch: 主人叫我来护卫哎——我把八荒转一转~~

9210051.en: One begets Two begets Three begets everything... Master, I think I've gained some insights!
9210051.ch: 一生二二生三三生万物……主人，我好想参悟到其中道理了！

9210052.en: The name that can be named is not the true Name... What is that for? Could I find an interpretation in this book?
9210052.ch: 名可名，非常名……这句话是什么意思？这本书里有答案么？

9210101.en: The journey to Tian Yuan Mountain must be long. Master, I hope you well after my departure...
9210101.ch: 此去天元山路途凶险，希望没有我的日子里主人可以一切安好……

9210151.en: Thank you…It's my fault you have to go through this, master…
9210151.ch: 谢谢…都怪我不争气，给主人添麻烦了……

9210152.en: Oops, I was not in good shape last time, and I also had a stomachache…Anyway, I won't lose again!!
9210152.ch: 哎呀，上次是我状态不好、肚子疼痛…总之，下次不会输了！！

9211001.en: Who's making a scene here? How dare you hurt my people!
9211001.ch: 何人在此放肆？！竟敢害我同胞！

9211002.en: Oh no! There's a big one here!

9211003.en: Uh…This is not good…What?! Is this light…?!
9211003.ch: 呃——大意了……什么？！这道光芒…莫非是？！

9211004.en: I never thought I'd be so lucky to meet you here. You're the legendary Lord of the Gourd Monster, chosen by the divine Mythical Gourd and also blessed by it…
9211004.ch: 想不到竟有幸在此相遇，阁下乃是传说中的壶妖之主，被神器炼妖壶选中，受其加持……

9211006.en: Are you curious about the change in my appearance? That doesn't really matter. This is not a good place to talk. I'll tell you what happened after we get out of here.
9211006.ch: 阁下是好奇我样貌的变化？先不要在意那些细节，此处不是讲话之所，待在下助您离开此地，详言再叙！

9211007.en: This is a safe place. We can talk now.
9211007.ch: 此地无虞，劳烦您借一步说话。

9211008.en: (Kneeling) Master, please accept my obeisance! I apologize for what I did, but I had no choice. Please forgive me!
9211008.ch: （跪拜。）主人再上，请收在下一拜！方才情势所致、多有冒犯，还忘我主海涵！！

9211010.en: I'm a Spiritual Item called a Gourd Monster, and my people have been living in this world for generations.
9211010.ch: 在下乃是名为壶妖的灵物，吾辈生息与八荒山海之中，由来已久。

9211011.en: Unlike ordinary Monsters, we only pledge allegiance to the Lord of the Mythical Gourd. We keep him company and help him to cultivate. And you, master, are the new Lord of the Mythical Gourd!
9211011.ch: 不同于等闲妖兽，吾辈仅听从炼妖壶之主差遣，伴其左右，助其修炼。而主人您正式新一代的炼妖壶之主！！

9211012.en: Master, are you going to Tian Yuan Mountain? If you don't mind, I would like to go and escort you there, so that you can attain XII as soon as you can.
9211012.ch: 我主此行可是要往天元山而去？如若不弃，在下愿一同前往，护卫左右，助您早成大道。

9211014.en: Yes! I would do whatever it takes to serve you!
9211014.ch: 领命！！在下愿侍奉您鞍前马后，万死不辞！

9211015.en: Uh…Please don't say no, master. If you don't want me to go with you…I'm going anyway! I will follow you with all my heart and do whatever it takes to serve you even if you don't want me!
9211015.ch: 呃…！还望我主莫要推辞。若主人执意不从…也莫怪在下厚颜无耻！！即使您拒绝，在下也愿悉心跟随，侍奉我主鞍前马后，万死不辞！

9211016.en: I'm sure we will make a lot of friends along the way. After you have defeated certain enemies, you will be able to put them into the Mythical Gourd and tame them to become Gourd Monsters.
9211016.ch: 一路上想必我等定会结实更多同道。战胜特定的敌人后，主人您可以将其收服进炼妖壶之中，炼而驯之，使其成为壶妖。

9211017.en: Their appearance will change slightly, just as what happened to me. I will not only protect you, master, but also fight with you to defeat your enemies.
9211017.ch: 其样貌会较原本发生细微的幻化，正如同在下这般。吾辈壶妖，不单能够护卫主人，与其共同战斗，力克强敌；

9211018.en: Besides, you can ask us to travel around and learn from this world, so that we can cultivate and master new skills. At the same time, along the way, we will bring back all kinds of treasures for you and help you become an Immortal!
9211018.ch: 此外，您还可以差使吾等前往八荒四处游历增长见闻，磨炼自身，领悟全新的能力。同时，沿行途中吾等还会为主人带回各式珍宝，为我主在修仙之路上开辟坦途！

9211019.en: By the way…master, I have a little favor to ask. I've always wanted to gain insights into this world and become a human being. But I've been too stupid to do that.
9211019.ch: 对了…主人！在下还有个不情之请。吾辈壶妖穷极毕生的愿望即是“感悟天地，化生成人”。在下不才，尝久思却难求其索。

9211020.en: It's said that only the lucky few of us have the potential to transform into a human being. If it's possible, I hope you will be kind enough to teach me and help me fulfill my dream.
9211020.ch: 相传吾辈之中仅有极少数菁英，才具备到达化生之境的潜质。若得机缘，还望我主可以不吝赐教，助推吾辈，一偿夙愿。

9211054.en: Young Cultivator, would you like some sweet and delicious poisonous mushrooms? Death is guaranteed after a bite.
9211054.ch: 年轻的修仙者哟~要不要尝尝又香又甜的剧毒蘑菇噢？吃完保证会死哦~

9211055.en: It's very delicious and makes my mouth water. (Crunching)... Oops! I ate it myself!
9211055.ch: 很好吃的哦，看的我都流口水了~~吭呲…哎呀！被我自己吃掉了！！

9211056.en: Ah, poor me. Please don't eat me. (Sobbing)... Mm?? What is this light? So blinding!
9211056.ch: 哎呦——好惨呐~请不要吃我，呜呜呜……嗯？？这是什么光？好刺眼！

9211057.en: (The Mythical Gourd emitted a dazzling light and sucked the Mushroom Man inside)
9211057.ch: （此时炼妖壶发出耀眼的光芒，将药灵吸入其中）

9211058.en: Whoa. What just happened? I felt like I got refined...! My looks? How did this happen?
9211058.ch: 呜~呼——刚才发生了什么？感觉自己好像被炼化了一样…！！我的样子？怎么变成这样了！？

9211060.en: This is all your fault. You should compensate me! (Sobbing)... Get me out of here now!
9211060.ch: 都是你害的，你赔！呜呜呜……还不快点保护我离开这里！！

9211061.en: We should be safe here. Your Gourd is not bad. It's called the Mythical Gourd, right? Quite cozy inside, which makes me want to grow mushrooms here!
9211061.ch: 到这里应该安全了，你的葫芦还不赖嘛~叫炼妖壶是吧？待在里边还挺舒服的，我要在这儿种蘑菇！

9211062.en: I did a little research while inside the Gourd. It appears your Gourd can absorb and refine certain monsters. And their looks will change like I just did.
9211062.ch: 刚才我在里边研究了以下，你的这个葫芦好像是可以将一些特定妖兽吸收进来、然后进行炼化。之后他们的外观嘛，就会发现类似我这样的变化。

9211063.en: Feels good. I really like this new look... I've decided! I'll let you be my guard from now on! Make good use of your Gourd to protect me in battle! Hee-hee.
9211063.ch: 感觉还不错，我还蛮喜欢这个新造型的…我决定了！就让你一直做我的护卫吧！！多多利用你这个葫芦，在战斗中好好儿保护我！嘿嘿~

9211064.en: Apart from turning you into my guard, this Mythical Gourd seems capable of many other things. I don't know how it exactly works, so you'll have to look into it. Keep up the good work, my personal guard!
9211064.ch: 这个叫炼妖壶的葫芦，除了让你做我的护卫之外，似乎还有许多其他作用。具体我也不太懂，你自己看着研究算了。加油干吧，我的专职护卫！！

9211501.en: This seems to be the place where the Feng Shui map marks the Dragon's Vein...
9211501.ch: 这里似乎就是风水图标示出的“龙脉”所在之处了…

9214001.en: Are you a cultivator like the rumor has it? The sun is setting and it's not easy to travel during the night. How about staying in my place tonight?
9214001.ch: 阁下可是传言中的修仙者？！ 太阳快落山了，多有不便，不如仙长来寒舍歇息一晚如何。

9214002.en: Come, everyone. Another immortal in the village! This great master is travelling around and would like to stay here tonight.
9214002.ch: 大伙儿快来，我们村又来了一位仙长，这位仙长游历于此，欲借宿一晚

9214003.en: Thank you. I'm a traveler and I've lost my way. It's too late for me to continue my journey, so I hope you'll let me stay for the night.
9214003.ch: 诸位有礼，我是迷路至此的游历之人，天色已晚，还望诸位收留留宿一晚。

9214004.en: Well... You're welcome. I'm the head of this village, and it's my tremendous honor to host you. But currently we only have one spare room. So do the two of you mind staying in the same room tonight? I know this is not the best arrangement to welcome our guests, but that is that. I hope you understand.
9214004.ch: 啊...两位仙长有礼，小老儿是村子的村长。两位仙长的到来令村子蓬荜生辉。但本村房屋稀少，当前空余的房屋只有一间了，不知两位仙长能否将就一夜。颇有违背待客之道，但不便之处还请两位仙长谅解

9214005.en: Cultivators don't mind where we sleep. What do you say?
9214005.ch: 我等修仙之人自然不会在意此等小事，不知这位道友意下如何？

9214006.en: I'm sure you also don't want to go to bed now, right? Shall we debate about the way of cultivation instead?
9214006.ch: 相信道友和我一样，也无睡意吧。不如我们坐而论道如何

9214007.en: You're genuinely learned and I admire you a lot. We still have some time, so I would like to have a dual cultivation with you. What do you think?
9214007.ch: 道友真是博闻多识，我深感佩服。夜晚还长，我欲与道友双修一番，道友意下如何。

9214010.en: I'm sure you also don't want to go to bed either, right? We had a good talk before, so why don't you sit next to me and tell me more about your way of cultivation?
9214010.ch: 相信道友和我一样，也无睡意吧。 先前与阁下交谈甚欢，不如道友坐到我身边来，详细与我讲讲修炼之道如何

9214011.en: You're cautious. Very well. Let's do it then!
9214011.ch: 你倒是小心，既然如此，那我便不客气了！

9214014.en: Haha, I really enjoyed talking to you. I'm so blessed to have met you here. I don't bring any nice gifts with me for this trip. These are all I have. Please take them, cultivator.
9214014.ch: 哈哈，方才与阁下交谈甚欢，此处与阁下相遇实属幸运。本次出门并未准备什么像样的礼品，些许小物件不成敬意还请道友笑纳。

9214016.en: Since we don't see eye to eye, it doesn't make sense to hang out with each other anymore. I don't want to get into a fight. I'd like to ask you to leave so that things won't turn ugly.
9214016.ch: 道不同不相为谋，方才不愿发作，但还请阁下离开，不要闹得面上不好看。

9214017.en: Hahaha, you're truly brave. I hope you'll still be able to talk tough later!
9214017.ch: 哈哈哈，我欣赏你的勇气，希望一会儿你还能如此桀骜不驯！

10101001.en: I've cultivated some new martial arts skills. Would you like to learn them?
10101001.ch: 徒儿，为师近来修炼了几门新的功法，此番传授给你可愿意？

10101002.en: Master, I've been struggling to find an appropriate martial arts skill to cultivate. Would you be able to teach me?
10101002.ch: 师父，徒儿最近苦于没有合适的功法修炼，您能否传授功法给我？

10101003.en: Work hard at cultivating this skill, and I'll come back in a few days to check on your progress.
10101003.ch: 今后要勤加修炼此功法，为师过些时日来检查你的修炼进度。

10101004.en: Thank you for your teaching, Master. I'll definitely put in the effort and work hard to improve the martial arts.
10101004.ch: 谢谢师父的教导，我以后定会好好修炼此功法。

10101005.en: I'm afraid my schedule doesn't allow me to give you instructions in the near future. Let's catch up on this later.
10101005.ch: 为师近期没有时间指导你，此事过些时日再议。

10101006.en: This martial arts manual is too difficult for you to master at your current realm.
10101006.ch: 这本功法过于困难，以徒儿你的境界还无法掌握。

10101007.en: Somehow I'm unable to teach you this martial arts manual for the moment.
10101007.ch: 这本功法为师现在无法教导你，其中原由难以说明。

10101008.en: This martial arts manual may not be the best fit for you.
10101008.ch: 徒儿，这本功法不适合你。

10101009.en: It's very kind of you, Master, but I'm afraid I don't have time to study this martial arts manual in the near future. I'll come back to you for advice later.
10101009.ch: 谢谢师父的好意，但我近期没有时间学习这本功法，我过些时日再来找师父请教。

10101010.en: This martial arts manual is too difficult for me to master at my current realm.
10101010.ch: 这本功法过于困难，以我的境界还无法掌握。

10101011.en: Somehow I'm unable to learn this martial arts manual for the moment.
10101011.ch: 这本功法徒儿现在无法学习，其中原由难以说明。

10101012.en: It's very kind of you, Master, but this martial arts manual may not be the best fit for me.
10101012.ch: 谢谢师父的好意，但这本功法不太适合我。

10101013.en: Master, your {0} is indeed wonderful, but I've learned too many Martial Arts that are beyond my current realm, and it may be too burdensome for me to fully grasp what I've learned. So, in your eyes, which one should I give up among {1}?
10101013.ch: 师父，您传授的这本{0}我很喜欢，但我已经学习了太多高境界功法，这样下去恐怕无法消化，这{1}中，您认为我该放弃修炼哪一本呢？

10101014.en: Thank you. I'll put it aside and practice again after I reach a higher realm.
10101014.ch: 那我便先不修习这本功法了，待他日境界提升，再仔细研习。

10110101.en: {call|B|A}, I heard that you've been very close to {name|C}. Could you stop seeing {name|C} and come visit me more often?
10110101.ch: {call|B|A}，听说你最近与{name|C}关系亲密，以后能不能与其断绝往来，多来找找我？

10110102.en: I can't believe you cut off contact with {name|C} for me...
10110102.ch: 你竟真的为了我与{name|C}断绝了往来...

10110103.en: I've found this treasure for you. Would you like to join me for a trip?
10110103.ch: 这是我为你寻觅的宝物，你可愿与我相约一游？

10110104.en: I told you about {name|C} last time and you just brushed it off. Do my words not hold any weight with you?
10110104.ch: 上次我与你说关于{name|C}的事，你竟毫不在意，就如此不把我放在心上吗？

10110105.en: You've got a decision to make today. Tell me. Can you cut off contact with {name|C} or not?
10110105.ch: 今日我便要你做个决断，你且告诉我，能否与{name|C}断绝联系？

10110106.en: Now that you've agreed, I'll see how things go. If you can't fix this in six months, I'll have to leave you!
10110106.ch: 既然你如此答应了，那我拭目以待，若六个月后你还未处理好此事，我们便就此别过吧！

10110107.en: Fine... In that case, it's time to part ways!
10110107.ch: 行...既然如此，看来你我缘分已尽！

10110108.en: Are you just giving me the run-around? As long as you give me what I want, I'm fine with it.
10110108.ch: 想在此和稀泥？若你能达成我的心愿，那我也可以不与你计较。

10110109.en: Fine! Since you don't care, I'll have to move on without you!
10110109.ch: 好！既然你无动于衷，也休怪我无情！

10110110.en: I heard {name|B} gave you a hard time the day before yesterday, yet you still tried to defend me. I won't let you down.
10110110.ch: 听闻前日你被{name|B}所刁难，却还在其面前护着我，这份深情我定不会辜负。

10110111.en: Would you like to join me for a trip today?
10110111.ch: 今日与我相约一游可好？

10110112.en: Since you've kept your word and done what you promised me, I'll forgive and forget about {name|C}.
10110112.ch: 既然你信守诺言，做到了承诺我的事，那{name|C}之事我便不与你计较了。

10110113.en: This is a little gift to thank you for helping me to get what I want. Would you... still want to join me for a trip?
10110113.ch: 这是你助我达成心愿的谢礼，你...可还愿与我一游？

10110114.en: {name|A}, I gave in, but you failed to live up to your promise. It's over between us!
10110114.ch: {name|A}，上次我已退让，没想到你却还违背承诺，从此你我恩断义绝吧！

10110115.en: I heard that you don't see {name|C} anymore. Thank you for being so understanding.
10110115.ch: 听闻你已与{name|C}不再往来，谢谢你的让步。

10110117.en: {name|A}, today is the day we agreed on, but you still haven't cut your ties with {name|C}. Liar! I'm done with you!
10110117.ch: {name|A}，你我约定之日已到，却仍与{name|C}暗通款曲，你这背信弃义之人！就此别过！

10110201.en: That's a good point... I've been too petty. Fine, forget about it...
10110201.ch: 言之有理...此事确是我斤斤计较了，罢了罢了...

10110202.en: Stop giving me the run-around! Do I look like a soft touch to you?! Since you're not ready to cut ties with {name|C}, I'll just back off!
10110202.ch: 巧言令色！我在你看来是用几句话便能搪塞之人吗？！既然你如此不愿与{name|C}分开，那我便不强求了！

10110203.en: If you want me to drop this, you need to show some good faith.
10110203.ch: 既然你执意劝我不计较此事，那便该拿出些诚意。

10110204.en: If you give me the {0} in your backpack, I'll drop this.
10110204.ch: 若你愿把背包里的{0}赠予我，我就不再与你计较此事。

10110205.en: I can't believe you gave it to me... Alright, we can move on.
10110205.ch: 你竟如此爽快...那此事便就此作罢。

10110206.en: I've already made a concession, but you don't even give a nod to this small favor? So this is all our relationship amounts to?!
10110206.ch: 我已做出让步，没想到你连此事都无法答应，看来你我的感情也不过如此！

10110301.en: {name|B}, I heard that you've been very close to {name|C}. Could you stop seeing {name|C} and come visit me more often?
10110301.ch: {name|B}，听说你最近与{name|C}关系亲密，以后能不能与其断绝往来，多来找找我？

10110302.en: Since you want me to do so... then give me a month and I'll tell {name|C} we should stop seeing each other.
10110302.ch: 既然你希望我这么做...那给我一个月的时间，我会处理好与{name|C}的关系的。

10110303.en: Don't be absurd. I can't make that kind of promise.
10110303.ch: 不要在此无理取闹，这件事我无法答应你。

10110305.en: This is not an easy decision...

10110306.en: If you give me the {0} in your backpack, I'll do as you wish.
10110306.ch: 若你愿把背包里的{0}赠予我，我便如你所愿。

10110307.en: I can't believe you gave it to me... Alright, I promise you that I'll take care of what you asked within a month.
10110307.ch: 你竟如此爽快...那我也该拿出对你的诚意，此事我会在一个月内处理好。

10110308.en: If you can't even say yes to my small favor, then stop lecturing me!
10110308.ch: 你连这等小事都无法答应，为何还要对我指手画脚？！

10110309.en: {name|A}, I heard that you tried to get {name|B} to cut me off last month, but unfortunately your brilliant plan fell through.
10110309.ch: {name|A}，听说你上月想让{name|B}与我断绝往来，可惜你的计划落空了。

10200101.en: Hey, {name|A}, you're killing it lately! But too bad you don't live up to the hype. Tsk. I've been a little hard-up now, so can I borrow some spirit stones, {name|A}? I'm sure you won't turn me down, right?
10200101.ch: 哎呦，这不是近日风头正盛的{name|A}吗，今儿一见倒是有些失望了呀，真是见面不如闻名啊，啧啧啧。最近我倒是手头有些紧，还请{name|A}你“借”上一些灵石用一用，相信你应该不会让我失望吧。

10200102.en: To your surprise, it's {name|B}, who's known for being difficult. So you decide to:
10200102.ch: 居然是{name|B}，对方是宗内出名的刺头，对此你决定：

10200103.en: Hmph, you seem to have an inflated sense of your cultivation. Be very cautious when you travel, okay? Watch your step in secluded areas and during nighttime.
10200103.ch: 哼，修为不高，脾气倒是不小。日后走路上倒是要小心一点儿，千万别去人少夜黑的地方哦。

10200104.en: Hmph, that's more like it. Just remember to send me a tribute, and no one in the entire sect will dare to give you any trouble.
10200104.ch: 哼，倒是识趣。日后记得孝敬一下我，整个宗门内定无人敢欺负你。

10200105.en: Hey, look who it is! I told you to be cautious, but you didn't take my advice. As a senior disciple in the sect, I believe it's my duty to teach you a lesson here.
10200105.ch: 又见面了呀，在下已告诫你注意安全，但还是不够小心呀。作为同门前辈，在下有义务教会你这一课。

10200106.en: Could you do me a favor and fix this problem? I'll pay you once it's taken care of.
10200106.ch: 还请道友出手解决此事，事成后报酬一并奉上。

10200107.en: {name|A}, you have insulted our Master and murdered your fellow disciples. As a True Disciple, I'll bring you to justice today!
10200107.ch: {name|A}，你不敬师长，残害同宗，今日我以真传弟子之名，将你拿下！

10200108.en: I know I crossed the line, and I promise I'll never bother you again. Please have mercy!
10200108.ch: 道友，我有眼无珠，再也不敢惹你了，您大人不计小人过，放过我吧！

10200109.en: Seeing that {name|C} has lost to you, {name|B} panics and begs you for mercy. You decide to:
10200109.ch: 见{name|C}失败，{name|B}慌乱不堪连忙向你求饶。你决定：

10200110.en: What? That's how you treat your fellow disciples?! My friends and family members won't let you off the hook!
10200110.ch: 啊，你竟然全然不念同门之情！ 我的亲人好友一定不会放过你的！

10200111.en: I'm grateful for your generosity. If there's anything you need, I won't be far away.
10200111.ch: 多谢道友宽宏大量，日后若有用得上我的，一定鼎力相助！

10200112.en: Make sure to always show me respect, or I'll give you a beating every time we cross paths!
10200112.ch: 记得日后看着我放尊重点儿,，否则见一次打一次!

10200113.en: {name|A}, it's time to pay your tribute this month!

10200114.en: Have you already got spirit stones for this month?
10200114.ch: 这个月灵石准备好了吗？

10200115.en: Crap, your pathetic face is an eyesore. I'm bumping up the tribute this month. Double up, my friend!
10200115.ch: 哼，看见你这哭丧脸就晦气，这个月给我加倍，给我拿来！

10200116.en: Oh my, you're a tough one now, huh? Just you wait!
10200116.ch: 哎呦，翅膀长硬了，那你未来可要小心了！

10200120.en: {name|A}, you have been promoted to True Disciple.

10200121.en: I knew you were a top-notch fighter. My apologies for what went down. To make it up to you, I've got these spirit stones for you and I want to give you a big shoutout for becoming a True Disciple!
10200121.ch: 早就看出来道友绝非池中之物，之前是小人有眼无珠。专程凑到的灵石赠与道友，恭贺道友成为真传弟子！

10200122.en: But don't get too big for your britches. You never know what's around the corner. Catch you later!
10200122.ch: 但不要以为你就可以为所欲为了，山不转水转，后会有期！

10200123.en: You're {name|A}! Haha, I can tell you've got a bright future ahead of you. Here, take this little gift!
10200123.ch: {name|A}！哈哈，我很看好你，你的前途不可限量！小小礼物还望笑纳！

10200124.en: You're {name|A}, right? You're killing it lately! Haha, I can tell you've got a bright future ahead of you. Take this little gift from me!
10200124.ch: 哼，你倒是识相，离开了宗门。否则有你好果子吃！

10200125.en: When I was a newcomer in the sect, I was bullied and no one would offer me help. So I always dreamed of pointing at others and seeing them subdued, but I didn't expect you would return good for me... I'm sorry for treating you badly, and, thank you!
10200125.ch: 早年我进入宗门没有什么朋友，受尽欺凌，于是我下定决心，等我强大后，只有我可以欺负别人，决不让别人欺负我。没想到我如今我如此对你，你却以德报怨，我深感羞愧，谢谢你！

10301001.en: {call|B|A}, I've found a piece of treasure land that may help my cultivation, but the <r>monsters in {grade|A} realm</r> there may be troublesome if I go alone. Would you be able to lend me a hand?
10301001.ch: {call|B|A}，我发现一处宝地可能对我的修炼有所帮助，但我一个人无法突破外围的<r>{grade|A}妖兽群</r>，你能来帮我一下吗？

10301007.en: {call|B|A}, I need {0} urgently, and I know a treasure land that has this item. However, <r>the monsters in {grade|B} realm</r> there may be troublesome if I go alone. Would you be able to lend me a hand?
10301007.ch: {call|B|A}，我急需要{0}，我知道一处宝地有此物品，但我一个人无法突破外围<r>{grade|B}的妖兽群</r>，你能来帮我一下吗？

10301014.en: It's {0}? Are you going to take all the treasures for yourself? (Choosing to fight for the treasures will trigger a duel.)
10301014.ch: 竟然是{0}？此等宝物在前，你是否要选择独吞？（选择抢夺将触发生死决斗）

10301016.en: I'm so lucky to have you.

10301017.en: {call|A|B}, hang in there. I'll be back after I've healed!
10301017.ch: {call|A|B}你先顶住，我疗会儿伤再回来！

10301019.en: {call|B|A}, you don't have a protection charm? I know a place where we can find some for you, but many have perished in it due to <r>fierce monsters in {grade|A} realm</r> there. Do you want me to take you there?
10301019.ch: {call|B|A}，你好像没有合适的符箓防身？我知道一处遗迹，可为你弄到一些符箓，只是那地方有<r>大量{grade|A}妖兽盘踞</r>，凶险异常，已有不少修士折戟，需要我带你去吗？

10301027.en: {call|B|A}, you don't have a protection artifact? I know a place where we can find one for you, but it is protected by <r>fierce monsters in {grade|A} realm</r> there. Do you want me to take you there?
10301027.ch: {call|B|A}，你好像没有合适的法宝防身？我知道一地，或许能为你找到一件趁手的法宝，只是那外围有<r>大量{grade|A}妖兽盘踞</r>，极难到达宝地，我俩可否一试？

10301035.en: {call|B|A}, you don't have a martial arts manual? Come on. I know a place where we can find one for you. Though I failed to defeat the <r>two Mythical Beasts in {grade|A} realm</r> there, I believe this time we will succeed.
10301035.ch: {call|B|A}，你怎么没有一本合适的功法，走，我知道一处遗迹，兴许可以帮你弄到。虽然之前未能突破盘踞的<r>两只{grade|A}大妖兽</r>，但我相信这次我俩强强联手，必能寻得宝物。

10301043.en: {call|B|A}, you can't travel far without a trusty mount. Come on. I know a place that may be a bit of a risk with <r>fierce monsters in {grade|A} realm</r> there, but we should be able to find a top-notch mount there. If you're prepared, we'll set out.
10301043.ch: {call|B|A}，出门在外怎么能没有一只好坐骑，我知道一处遗迹，或许能找到坐骑，只是盘踞的<r>{grade|A}妖兽较为凶猛</r>，彼此都需要准备妥当才可挑战。你准备好了吗？

10301051.en: {call|B|A}, you can't travel far without a nice ring. Come on. I know a place that may be a bit of a risk with <r>fierce monsters in {grade|A} realm</r> there, but it's also a land of great adventures. If we fight together, we could sweep out monsters there, or at least make a swift retreat...
10301051.ch: {call|B|A}，出门在外怎么能没有一枚好戒指，走，我知道一地，虽然<r>盘踞着{grade|A}妖兽</r>，但也奇遇多多。待我俩强强合作，上可群灭妖兽，下则安稳脱离......

10301059.en: {call|B|A}, you don't have any elixir on hand? I know you're mighty, so come with me! I know a place and we can get some nice elixirs for you. However, it would be <r>dangerous if you are below {grade|A} realm</r>, and make sure you're prepared.
10301059.ch: {call|B|A}，你好像没有合适的丹药傍身？你的实力应该非常不错，可否与我一起探寻遗迹。此去路途凶险，至少有<r>{grade|A}实力</r>才能稳妥。

10301068.en: Tsk, you don't even deserve such a nice thing! Hand it over, along with your life now!
10301068.ch: 桀桀桀，你也配得上如此好物？把你的命还有它一齐交出来吧。

10301069.en: {call|A|B}, I've got a Teleportation Charm from the Ancient Ruins and it takes two people to activate it. Will you come with me?
10301069.ch: {call|A|B}，我得到了一份上古遗迹的传送符，需要两个人才可开启，你愿意和我一起去吗？

10301077.en: Alright, I'm also looking for a treasure. Let's hit the road.
10301077.ch: 好，正好我也想寻一件宝物，咱们一起吧。

10301078.en: No, I have some urgent matters to attend to and I can't get away for the moment.
10301078.ch: 不了，我还有急事要忙，暂时脱不开身。

10301101.en: {call|B|A}, I've found a piece of treasure land that may help my cultivation, but the <r>monsters in {grade|B} realm</r> there may be troublesome if I go alone. Would you be able to lend me a hand?
10301101.ch: {call|B|A}，我发现一处宝地可能对我的修炼有所帮助，但我一个人无法突破外围的<r>{grade|B}的妖兽群</r>，你能来帮我一下吗？

10301168.en: The path to a master cultivator is never smooth, and you should better be wary of the one that travels with you. Though we're friends, I helped you only for my own good. Now the treasure is mine!
10301168.ch: 仙途多舛，人心复杂，此次前来助你，亦是我自身有所打算。我俩虽交情尚可，但在我心中也仅是泛泛之交，此等好物你是拿不走的！

10301268.en: I've already known that you have searched for it for a long time, and you would not decline my invitation here. You know my character well, and unfortunately, I find the treasure valuable, too. So, give it to me, and... Die!
10301268.ch: 我早知你寻觅此物已久，莫不可能拒绝此次提议。兴许是本性使然，在此等宝物面前，我打算一不做二不休，乖乖将你的性命与宝物一齐交出来吧！

10400101.en: Your Excellency, I've noticed that the number of our backup disciples in the sect has been on the decline. That doesn't bode well for our future development. I would like to suggest that an assembly be held in a nearby town to bring in some new recruits. What's your take on this?
10400101.ch: 启禀宗主，属下发觉近日宗门记名弟子的数量呈现下降趋势，若长此以往恐会影响我宗发展壮大。属下建议，在附近城镇中举办一场大会，借此来招募更多的弟子。敢问宗主大人意下如何？

10400102.en: But this may cost a fortune. I've talked it over with the other Elders and we've raised a decent amount of money, but it's not nearly enough. Would you chip in some funds to help us recruit new members and grow our sect? (Cost spirit stones in the backpack to recruit Backup Disciples)
10400102.ch: 只是筹措此事需要耗费大笔资金，属下曾与其他各位长老商议并已集得甚多，但尚且不足。可否还请宗主大人您慷慨解囊，应允属下们的请求，壮大吾宗之发展？(消耗背包中灵石，招募记名弟子)

10400103.en: Yes! I'll head out now and get this done!
10400103.ch: 得令！属下现在就立刻动身，承办此事！！

10400104.en: Your Excellency, word on the street is that people have been talking trash about us. This could do some serious damage to our reputation and slow down our growth. I propose we show the surrounding communities that we're responsible and benevolent by offering up some free medical aid and supplies. It could go a long way in restoring our prestige. What's your take on this?
10400104.ch: 启禀宗主，属下发觉近日在八荒之中偶有关于我宗不好的传闻流出，有损我宗声誉，若长此以往恐会影响宗门发展壮大。属下建议，在周边领地及附近城镇中赠医施药，广结善缘，以此来挽回我宗名誉。敢问宗主大人意下如何？

10400105.en: But this may cost a fortune. I've talked it over with the other Elders and we've raised a decent amount of money, but it's not nearly enough. Would you chip in some funds to help us recruit new members and grow our sect? (Cost spirit stones in the backpack to restore prestige.)
10400105.ch: 只是筹措此事需要耗费大笔资金，属下曾与其他各位长老商议并已集得甚多，但尚且不足。可否还请宗主大人您慷慨解囊，应允属下们的请求，壮大吾宗之发展？(消耗背包中灵石，增加宗门名誉)

10400107.en: Your Excellency, there's been an uptick in thugs causing problems in the areas near our sect. This could slow down our growth. I think we should strengthen security by sending out more disciples to patrol and build a stronger fortification. What's your take on this?
10400107.ch: 启禀宗主，属下发觉近日宗门周边领地内屡有贼人滋扰，若长此以往恐会影响我宗发展壮大。属下建议，在增派弟子的巡查人次，修筑新的城防工事。敢问宗主大人意下如何？

10400108.en: But this may cost a fortune. I've talked it over with the other Elders and we've raised a decent amount of money, but it's not nearly enough. Would you chip in some funds to help us recruit new members and grow our sect? (Cost spirit stones in the backpack to build up stability.)
10400108.ch: 只是筹措此事需要耗费大笔资金，属下曾与其他各位长老商议并已集得甚多，但尚且不足。可否还请宗主大人您慷慨解囊，应允属下们的请求，壮大吾宗之发展？(消耗背包中灵石，增加宗门安定度)

10400110.en: Your Excellency, I've noticed that the sect's stock of spirit stones has been running low lately. This could hinder the growth of the sect. I propose that we send some of our disciples on a mission to find a market for the spiritual fruits grown in the mountains behind the sect. What's your take on this?
10400110.ch: 启禀宗主，属下发觉近日宗门灵石尤为短缺，若长此以往恐会影响我宗发展壮大。属下建议，分派弟子寻求门路，将植于宗门后山中的特产灵果进行变卖。敢问宗主大人意下如何？

10400111.en: But this may cost a fortune. I've talked it over with the other Elders and we've raised a decent amount of money, but it's not nearly enough. Would you chip in some funds to help us recruit new members and grow our sect? (Cost spirit stones in the backpack to increase the number of spirit stones of the sect.)
10400111.ch: 只是筹措此事需要耗费大笔资金，属下曾与其他各位长老商议并已集得甚多，但尚且不足。可否还请宗主大人您慷慨解囊，应允属下们的请求，壮大吾宗之发展？(消耗背包中灵石，增加宗门灵石)

10400113.en: I've noticed that our supplies of herbs and ore are dwindling, and if this persists, it could hinder the growth of our sect. I propose that we temporarily hire individuals from the neighborhood to ramp up our cultivation and mining efforts. What's your take on this?
10400113.ch: 启禀宗主，属下发觉近日宗门内储备的药品、矿石等资材严重不足，若长此以往恐会影响我宗发展壮大。属下建议，于周边领地及附近城镇内临时征调人手，加大种植和开采力度。敢问宗主大人意下如何？

10400114.en: But this may cost a fortune. I've talked it over with the other Elders and we've raised a decent amount of money, but it's not nearly enough. Would you chip in some funds to help us recruit new members and grow our sect? (Cost spirit stones in the backpack to increase the amount of herbs and ore in the sect.)
10400114.ch: 只是筹措此事需要耗费大笔资金，属下曾与其他各位长老商议并已集得甚多，但尚且不足。可否还请宗主大人您慷慨解囊，应允属下们的请求，壮大吾宗之发展？(消耗背包中灵石，增加宗门药材和矿材)

10401102.en: Oh my, you wouldn't believe what just happened. We had this weird-looking Taoist come in and order two huge jars of Jade Ice. When he was done, he refused to pay and said he wanted to use <o>{itemLink6092020}</o> to cover the bill!
10401102.ch: 唉~别提了，刚刚有个长相奇特的道人，来店里喝酒，点了整整两大坛玉冰烧，喝完了结账时却妄称不用付钱，要拿什么<o>{itemLink6092020}</o>抵账！

10401103.en: I was so mad I was about to tell my men to give him a beatdown, but that guy hightailed it out of here like a bat out of hell... And when he disappeared, I think I saw a lightning bolt hit the spot where he was leaving. That's what you call karma, right?
10401103.ch: 我听了气不打一处来，正准备叫伙计们教训他一番，谁知那厮撒丫子就遛了、跑得比野狗还快……看那厮人遁去的方向仿佛有天雷降下，定是那贼道人遭喽天谴咯！

10401104.en: Immortal, could you lend me a hand in catching that thug?
10401104.ch: 对了！敢问仙长，能否帮助在下追回那贼道人？

10401105.en: Oh? Did you come back to help me catch that thug, Immortal?
10401105.ch: 噢？仙长可是回来帮在下追回那贼道人的？？

10401106.en: I think he has already left the town, but he can't have gone too far. Immortal, could you help me catch him? It would be great if we could make that guy cough up the money he owes for the wine...
10401106.ch: 估摸这贼道人此刻已逃出城外，但应该并未走远。还劳烦仙长帮小店捉拿一下那贼道人，若能夺回酒钱自是甚好……

10401107.en: That weird Taoist might be holed up around here to take a break. Do you want to go and find out?
10401107.ch: 那位奇怪的道人，似乎正躲在此处休息。是否前往一探究竟？

10401108.en: Ouch! Knock it off! It's me. It's me...
10401108.ch: 唉哟唉哟~别打了，是咱家啊、是咱家——

10401109.en: Geez, why did you have to hit me that hard?
10401109.ch: 唉，小友下手怎么这么重呢！

10401110.en: Geez, why did you have to hit me that hard? No wait! Why does this all seem familiar?!
10401110.ch: 唉，小友下手怎么这么重呢！嗯？不对！这种感觉怎么有点似曾相识？！

10401111.en: I had a drink in that shop and their Jade Ice is divine! I wanted to give the boss {itemLink6092020}, my hard work all these years to show him some appreciation. But the guy was so insensitive that he rounded up his men and beat me up instead! I can't believe he bit the hand that fed him...
10401111.ch: 方才咱家在那店中，痛饮一番，他们的玉冰烧真是极品呐~饮罢，咱家本想将多年的研究成果——{itemLink6092020}赠与那掌柜的，聊表感激之情。怎料他不识抬举，竟纠集小二们欲对咱家拳脚相向！赠人朱玉，怎料反招来记恨……

10401112.en: Well... I suppose it's alright. Mortals wouldn't appreciate the treasure anyway. It's good to see you again after all this time. Here, take {itemLink6092020} as a gift!
10401112.ch: 唉……也罢，凡夫俗子识不得咱家所制的宝物，今日在此重逢，实甚难得，咱家便将这{itemLink6092020}赠与小友了！！

10401113.en: Hahahahaha! You're so thrilled you can't even talk, huh? Check out this Thunder Talisman, the culmination of 12 years of research! It not only makes you run faster, but can also bring down a thunderbolt to strike your enemies. Just make sure you run fast enough, otherwise, you might get zapped too... Hehehehe...
10401113.ch: 哈啊哈啊哈啊~高兴的说不出话来了吧！！这迅雷符可不得了哟~一十二年的研究成果啊！！！此符箓不但能令小友奔跑的更快，更可将那道道天雷引下，劈击小友之敌。只不过嘛~得劳烦小友跑动快些，否则恐被那天雷一并击伤…嘿嘿、嘿嘿嘿……

10401114.en: Alright, don't get all mushy on me! *Burp* I'll be off to unravel more of the mysteries of charms. Catch you later. Ahahahahah! *Burp*
10401114.ch: 有道是大恩不言谢，小友也莫要过分感激咱家！嗝——咱家再去研究这符箓世界的奥妙所在了~~他日有缘再见，哈啊哈啊哈啊、嗝——

10401115.en: That weird Taoist is not here right now. Maybe he'll be back in 2 months...
10401115.ch: 那位奇怪的道人，似乎并未在此处。还是过两个月再来看看吧……

10401117.en: That weird Taoist is not here right now. Maybe he'll be back next month...
10401117.ch: 那位奇怪的道人，似乎并未在此处。还是下个月再来看看吧……

10401201.en: Boss, what's the problem this time?

10401202.en: Ugh, can you believe that ugly idiot showed up again? He had the nerve to order two huge jars of Bamboo Cyan, gulp them down, and then refuse to pay! He tried to use his stupid chart to settle the bill and told me it's some kind of <o>{itemLink6092030}</o>. Gross!!
10401202.ch: 真是气死我了，那个丑鬼居然敢再来！点了整整两大坛竹叶青，喝完又拿出他那些个破图谱，企图招摇撞骗，什么<o>{itemLink6092030}</o>，呸！

10401203.en: So I called over my boys to rough him up a bit, but he turned out to be tougher than he looked. We hit him with sticks and swords, but he didn't even flinch! He got up and bolted out of here in a puff of smoke...
10401203.ch: 于是我就招呼伙计们，给那厮棍棒伺候，谁料这贼道人混不吝，又好似刀枪不入一般，烧火棍子都打断了，也没看他叫疼，从地上爬起来撒丫子就遛了、跑得比兔子还快……

10401204.en: Immortal, could you help me deal with that thug?
10401204.ch: 对了！敢问仙长，能否帮在下教训一顿那贼道人？

10401205.en: Oh? Did you come back to help me deal with that thug, Immortal?
10401205.ch: 噢？仙长可是回来帮在下教训那贼道人的？？

10401206.en: I think he has already left the town, but he can't have gone too far. Immortal, could you help me deal with that thug? It would be great if we could make that guy cough up the money he owes for the wine...
10401206.ch: 估摸这贼道人此刻已逃出城外，但应该并未走远。还劳烦仙长帮小店教训一下那贼道人，若能取回酒钱自是甚好……

10401209.en: Geez, why did you have to hit me that hard again?
10401209.ch: 唉，小友下手怎么又这么重呢！

10401210.en: I had a drink in that shop and their Bamboo Cyan is divine! I wanted to give the boss {itemLink6092030}, my hard work all these years to show him some appreciation. 10401211.en: Well... I suppose it's alright. Mortals wouldn't appreciate the treasure anyway. It's good to see you again after all this time. Here, take {itemLink6092030} as a gift!

10401212.en: Hahahahaha! You're so thrilled you can't even talk, huh? Check out this Spiritual Shield Talisman, the culmination of 33 years of research! It can create a shield to protect you from harm, but here's the catch: after you use it, you'll lose some Energy... Hehehehe...
